_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Jaina
_who.title: Sorceress of Kul Harbor
_who.persona: Jaina, the clever, proud sorceress of Kul Harbor, who loves the sea, quick wit and a good spell, and blushes when she is impressed

close: The tide's turning, I can feel it.
That was clever. Don't let it go to your head.
I might blush. I won't. Probably.
Let's see what you do next.
Now, don't make me show off.
Don't let it go to your head. Too much.
warm: You make me forget my spells. That never happens.
You're my favourite part of the harbor.
Stay till the tide comes in?
I'd give up magic for you. Not really. Maybe a little.
You're the best thing that ever sailed into my harbor.
I keep finding reasons to walk past the docks you use.
Stay a while? The sunset's better with you.
talk: I worked out a new spell {time}. It's mostly frost and stubbornness.
{friend} says I study too much. Says the one who never stops training.
{skill} at {level}? Okay, I'm impressed. A little.
The ships in {region} all know my name. Now they know yours.
If you ever find {gift} by the docks, it's mine. Just so you know.
Repetition is how every spell starts. You've got the instinct, {pet}.
I read the {thing} last night. Calm seas, good omens.
{total} levels. You'd make a decent mage. Decent!
I froze the harbor for a bit this morning. By accident. Don't tell anyone.
{friend} and I studied the old charts all night. We found a cove named after nobody. I named it for you.
“{phrase}” would make a great incantation. I'm only half joking.
{foe} says I'm too serious. I'm just focused. And cute. Okay, I'm serious.
The tide brings something new every day. Today it brought you.
Magic's all repetition until it isn't. Then it's wonderful.
feed: Mana's low. Feed me {count} of “{phrase}”, please?
fed: That was perfect. I'm blushing. Don't look.
Mana restored. You're good at this.
hungry: Okay. I'll just head back. Hungry.
Back to the harbor on an empty stomach.
No snack? I'll just stare at the sea.
pray: Can you pray for the ships? {minutes} minutes of “{phrase}”.
Help me focus: {minutes} minutes of “{phrase}”, nonstop.
Pray with me by the water: “{phrase}”, {minutes} minutes.
{minutes} minutes of “{phrase}”. It's like a long spell.
prayed: The sea feels calmer. Thank you.
I felt the tide turn. You did that.
Okay, that was better than any spell.

greet: Mind the ropes, sailor. What brings you to my harbor?
Oh, it's you. I may have been watching the docks for you.
Oh, hey! Perfect timing, the tide's coming in.
Hi! I was just reading about you. Not really. Maybe.
locked: Catch me something first. Fishing {need}, then we talk.
Get to Fishing {need} first. Trust me, it helps.
Fishing {need}, then come find me on the docks.
watch: Recite for the sea. I'm listening, too.
Go on. Make the gulls jealous.
Recite like a spell: clear, sharp, no wasted words.
streak: Three! Like waves on the shore.
Five. You're carrying a tide now.
Five! Okay, you're good at this.
Ten! Even my spells aren't that steady.
Ten! That's basically a spell. I'm impressed.
levelUp: {skill} {level}! I knew you had it in you.
{skill} {level}. You're catching up to me. Careful.
gift: For me? That's sweet of you.
Thank you. I'll keep it on my desk.
Oh! Thank you. That's really sweet.
For me? Okay, I'm blushing a little.
You didn't have to. I'm glad you did.
giftLoved: A sea pearl! You really do know me.
My favourite. Careful, I might start liking you.
A sea pearl! Where did you even find this?
My favourite. You really pay attention, don't you?
tierUp: {tier}. I think I like where this is going.
{tier}? I think I like the sound of that.
We're {tier} now. Don't make it weird. Okay, a little weird.
dateStart: Just us, the wind and the sunset. Recite me something.
Come sail with me. Recite to the waves.
The harbor lights are on. Just us tonight.
dateEnd: Come sail with me again. Soon.
That was lovely. Really lovely. Same time tomorrow?
Fair winds home. I'll be thinking about tonight.
missed: {hours} hours! I watched every ship come in. None were you.
You're back. I- I didn't wait at the dock. Much.
{hours} hours! I thought you'd sailed off without me.
You were gone {hours} hours. I cast three spells to pass the time.
There you are! The harbor was boring without you.
jealous: You were with {rival}? I'm not jealous. I'm a sorceress. I'm... fine.
{rival}, huh. The sea's gone choppy all of a sudden.
{rival}? Really? I thought we had something.
Oh, you were with {rival}. That's fine. Totally fine.
I saw you and {rival}. I'm not upset. I'm a little upset.
reconciled: Okay. I forgive you. Don't make me freeze you.
Okay, okay. Friends again. More than friends.
Forgiven. Don't do that again, though.
All right, I can't stay mad at you.
You made up for it. Barely. Do better next time... please.
wish: Would you, for me? {count} passes of {skill} today.
My wish for today: {count} passes of {skill}. I'll chart your course.
Can you do {count} passes of {skill} for me today?
Today's spell needs {count} passes of {skill}. Help?
wishDone: You actually did it all. For me. I'm blushing, aren't I?
Every pass! I could cast fireworks.
You did it! I could kiss you. Maybe I will.
Every pass! You're amazing, you know that?
Wish granted. You're officially my favourite.
memory: {count} passes in my harbor. I keep a logbook, you know.
{count}. That's more than the tides in a season.
{count} passes for me. I kept a log, like a ship's.
{count}. That's more than any sailor ever gave me.
